This is used to set up the data with necessary variables. Can be copied into any markdown.

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
master_data <- master_data |>
  bind_rows(
    new_data |>
      anti_join(master_data, by = c("Dispatch Assigned Incident Number (eResponse.03)", "Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)"))
  )

#patient call and transport volume is empty
master_data <- master_data|>
  mutate(
    date = mdy_hms(`Incident Date Time`),
    `mm/yyyy` = format(date, "%m/%Y"),
    month = my(`mm/yyyy`),
    season = case_when(
      month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 1,
      month(date) %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 2,
      month(date) %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 3,
      month(date) %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 4
    ),
    season_label = case_when(
      month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ paste("Winter", year(date)),
      month(date) %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ paste("Spring", year(date)),
      month(date) %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ paste("Summer", year(date)),
      month(date) %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ paste("Fall", year(date))
    )
  )

#Mutating call duration features
#Dispatch -> back in service
#dispatch -> destination
master_data <- master_data |>
  mutate(
    total_event_duration = difftime( mdy_hms(`Incident Unit Back In Service Date Time (eTimes.13)`), mdy_hms(`Incident Unit Notified By Dispatch Date Time (eTimes.03)`), units = "mins"),
    dispatch_destination = difftime( mdy_hms(`Incident Patient Arrived At Destination Date Time (eTimes.11)`), mdy_hms(`Incident Unit Notified By Dispatch Date Time (eTimes.03)`), units = "mins")
  )|>
    mutate(ready = as.numeric(lubridate::hms(`Incident Patient Arrived At Destination To Unit Back In Service In HHMMSS`),
                            units = "mins"
    ))

master_data <- master_data |>
  mutate(`EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` = case_when(
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "A" ~ "911 Day",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "B" ~ "911 Night",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "Transfer Shift" ~ "Transfer Shift",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "911 Night" ~ "911 Night",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "911 Day" ~ "911 Day",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "No Shift (Second Call/Call-In Transfer)" ~ "No Shift (Second Call/Call-In Transfer)",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "Event/Standby" ~ "Event/Standby",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "No Shift (Second Call)" ~ "No Shift (Second Call)"
  ))

master_data <- master_data |>
  mutate(mutual_aid = case_when(`Incident City Name (eScene.17)` == NA_character_ ~ NA_character_,
                                (!(`Incident City Name (eScene.17)` %in% c("Monkton Boro",
                                                                           "Monkton", "New Haven",
                                                                           "Starksboro",
                                                                           "Lincoln", "Bristol"))
                                 & (`Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)` != 
                                      "Transfer / Interfacility / Palliative Care")
  ) ~ "YES",
  TRUE ~ "NO"))

master_data <- master_data|>
  arrange(date)|>
  mutate(duration_before = lag(total_event_duration),
         event_before = lag(dispatch_destination),
         unit_ready_before = lag(ready), 
         time_between_last_call = difftime(lubridate::mdy_hms(`Incident Unit Notified By Dispatch Date Time (eTimes.03)`), 
           lubridate::mdy_hms(lag(`Incident Unit Back In Service Date Time (eTimes.13)`)), units = "mins"))

master_data <- master_data |>
  mutate(date_day = format(date, "%m/%d/%Y"))|>
  group_by(date_day)|>
  arrange(date)|>
  mutate(num_earlier_calls = row_number() - 1,
         num_calls_day = n())|>
  ungroup()

master_data <- master_data |>
  mutate(shift = case_when(
    is.na(`Incident Unit Notified By Dispatch Date Time (eTimes.03)`) ~ NA_character_,
    (hour(mdy_hms(`Incident Unit Notified By Dispatch Date Time (eTimes.03)`)) < 12) & (`EMS Shift (itResponse.005)`) == "911 Night" ~ "night2",
    (hour(mdy_hms(`Incident Unit Notified By Dispatch Date Time (eTimes.03)`)) >= 12) & (`EMS Shift (itResponse.005)`) == "911 Night"~ "night1",
         TRUE ~ "DAY")) |>
  mutate(shiftday = case_when(`EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "911 Night" ~ if_else(shift == "night2", paste(as_date(date) - days(1), "night"), paste(as_date(date), "night")),
                              TRUE ~ paste(as_date(date), "day")))|>
  select(-shift)

master_data <- master_data |>
  mutate(
      `Disposition Destination Full Address` = `Disposition Destination Full Address` |>
      str_to_upper() |>
      str_replace_all("[[:punct:]]", " ") |>
      str_squish()
  )
```

```{r}
brs_prompt <- "You are an EMS dispatch classification system.

## TASK
Determine what happened to the original BRS dispatch unit based on the patient care report narrative.

Classify each call into exactly ONE of three categories:

1. CANCELLED
2. TURNED OVER
3. ENGAGED NORMALLY

## CLASSIFICATION RULES

### 1. CANCELLED
Classify as CANCELLED when BRS was cancelled, canceled, released from the call, told to disregard the response, or returned to service without completing the call.

This includes:
- Cancelled or canceled prior to arrival (PTA).
- Cancelled by Central Dispatch.
- A named BRS unit being cancelled and returned to service.
- Any equivalent instruction ending BRS's involvement in the call.

Example:
BRS A3 was canceled and returned to service.
Classification: CANCELLED

### 2. TURNED OVER
Classify as TURNED OVER when BRS was busy, unavailable, unable to respond, or otherwise unable to handle the call, and responsibility was transferred to another agency.

This includes:
- Calls explicitly turned over or transferred to another agency.
- Another agency assuming responsibility because BRS was unavailable.
- BRS being unable to respond and another agency handling the incident.

Example:
BRS was busy on another call. Call turned over to MREMS.
Classification: TURNED OVER

BRS was busy on another call. Call sent mutual aid.
Classification: TURNED OVER

IMPORTANT:
A turnover is NOT automatically a cancellation. If BRS transfers responsibility because it cannot handle the call, classify as TURNED OVER.

If the narrative states that the call was sent mutual aid, then the call was transferred to another agency.

### 3. ENGAGED NORMALLY
Classify as ENGAGED NORMALLY when neither cancellation nor turnover applies.

This includes:
- BRS responding to the incident.
- BRS assessing or treating a patient.
- BRS transporting a patient.
- BRS assisting another agency while remaining involved.
- Any documented BRS involvement without evidence of cancellation or turnover.

## UNIT IDENTIFICATION RULES

- Do not require the narrative to explicitly identify the original dispatch unit.
- Assume a named or identified BRS unit refers to the original dispatch unit unless another or additional unit is explicitly identified.
- Connect cancellation or turnover statements to the previously mentioned BRS dispatch when the narrative describes a sequence of events.
- For example, BRS dispatched for an MVC. Cancelled PTA by Central Dispatch means CANCELLED.
- Do not invent additional units, events, or uncertainty.

## CLASSIFICATION PRIORITY

1. Explicit cancellation of BRS = CANCELLED.
2. BRS unable or unavailable to handle the call and responsibility transferred = TURNED OVER.
3. Neither condition applies = ENGAGED NORMALLY.

If both cancellation and turnover terminology appear, use the documented outcome. Explicit cancellation takes priority unless the narrative clearly establishes a transfer of responsibility instead.

## OUTPUT FORMAT

Return exactly:

Classification: CANCELLED / TURNED OVER / ENGAGED NORMALLY
Reason: One concise sentence citing the specific evidence.

Do not provide additional commentary or speculation.

PATIENT CARE REPORT NARRATIVE:
"
```

```{r}
# Create the chat configuration
brs_chat <- chat_ollama(
  model = "qwen3.5:9b",
  system_prompt = brs_prompt,
  params = params(
    reasoning_effort = "none",
    max_tokens = 100,
    temperature = 0
  )
)

# Classification function
classify_brs <- function(narrative) {

  if (is.na(narrative) || narrative == "") {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  # Create a clean conversation with no previous narratives
  chat1 <- brs_chat$clone()$set_turns(list())

  response <- chat1$chat(narrative)

  return(response)
}

master_data <- master_data |>
  mutate(
    llm_result = map2_chr(
      `Patient Care Report Narrative (eNarrative.01)`,
      llm_result,
      \(narrative, result) {
        if (is.na(result)) {
          classify_brs(narrative)
        } else {
          result
        }
      }
    )
  )

master_data <- master_data |>
  mutate(
    classification = str_extract(llm_result, "(?<=Classification: )(CANCELLED|TURNED OVER|ENGAGED NORMALLY)")
  )
```

```{r}
write.csv(master_data, "master_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
